decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory narratives regarding the spouse of Henrietta Maria O'Donel White Culpeper. Document 1 (D1) explicitly identifies 'Christopher Barton' as her husband in section D1S7 ('...sight of her husband... Christopher Barton'). Document 2 (D2) explicitly identifies 'Louis Symonds Tindal' as her husband in section D2S15 ('The marriage of Henrietta Maria O'Donel White Culpeper to Louis Symonds Tindal...') and D2S17. The prompt instructions state that distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers may coexist and that competing assertions are not automatically distinct valid answers unless they refer to different entities. Given the explicit textual evidence in both independent source documents identifying different men as her spouse, both names are retained as valid answers derived from the source material.
